financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Private placement of shares, pre-funded warrants and common warrants at $1.27 (gross proceeds estimated from share counts and price; net not stated)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The Shares and Warrants were issued to the Selling Stockholders in a private placement offering (the “Private Placement”) which closed on January 23, 2025.

financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Cash exercise of existing warrants at reduced price under inducement letters (gross proceeds)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The Company received aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $6.2 million from the exercise of the Existing Warrants by the Holder, before deducting offering expenses payable by the Company.

pre-funded warrants (“Pre-Funded Warrants”) to purchase up to 72,468 shares of Common Stock, at an exercise price of $0.001 per share
